title: refactor(wsl2d): extract ublk init to dedicated module
body:
## Summary

Extract ublk device creation, parameter setup, and queue initialization from `main.rs` into `ublk_init.rs` for modularity.

## Commits

- aee40e220740621339cf2bf2070ccb26e01aa69a

## Validation

- `cargo test` passes.
- `cargo clippy --all-targets` passes.

## Rollback trigger

Revert if WSL2 host stalls or memory lock leaks on standalone ublk creation.
